sources.snippet: ASR Paragraph Breaks A small text-in/text-out model that adds paragraph breaks to flat ASR output and changes nothing else. Speech-to-text output is punctuated and cased but arrives as one block, even from engines that mark sentence boundaries. This project hand-annotates where the paragraphs go and fine-tunes a small model on those annotations.

sources.snippet: ASR Paragraph Breaks Hand-annotated paragraph breaks for flat speech-to-text output. ASR engines emit punctuated, cased text as one block. This dataset pairs that block (text) with the same text split into paragraphs by a person (paragraphed).
